summary: Tested Playbooks & Runbooks end-to-end (backend pytest 15 tests + Playwright UI as anon, fresh student, instructor). Public list/filters/search/count, detail (locked/free/admin), runner (answers, actions, undo, outcome, report template, restart), SOP link, SOC Challenges side panel + recording + verdict reveal after submit (correct + wrong with wrong_step) + reopen + no-run state, instructor Playbook runs table, Content > Playbooks edit (422 Decision tree problem) and create custom all work. One real backend bug: GET /api/challenges/{cid}/playbooks returns 500 (KeyError 'order') whenever a custom/instructor-created playbook (no 'order' field) matches the challenge category - reproduced via API and via the UI 'New' form.

critical.issue: 500 KeyError 'order' in routes_playbooks.py line 51 `pbs.sort(key=lambda p: (..., p['order']))`. Playbooks created via /api/manage/playbooks (playbookTemplate / New button) have no 'order', so once an instructor creates a custom playbook for a category, the Open playbook panel for every challenge in that category breaks (frontend shows 'No playbook covers this alert type yet' because catch sets list=[]). Fix: p.get('order', 9999) and/or set order on create in routes_manage.

minor.issue: After a challenge is submitted (verdict revealed), the student can re-run the playbook and replace_one overwrites the stored run, flipping correct from false to true; the instructor table then shows the corrected run. Consider keeping the first pre-submission run (don't overwrite once submitted, or store first_run).
No check that the playbook belongs to the challenge's category; any ready playbook can be recorded against any challenge.

Returns full nodes/report for locked (paid) playbooks to any logged-in free student (card(p, True)); since it accepts any cid, a free student can fetch the full trees of all paid playbooks across categories. Paywall bypass if that's not intended.

pb-sop-impossible-travel (one of the 5 FREE playbooks) is status 'failed' after 3 attempts ('bad or looping node c1'); only retried on server restart. 'pending' counts failed items, so UI says '56 more being written' even for failed ones. Consider auto-retry or excluding failed from pending.

Error message for an empty answer target is 'Decision tree problem: bad or looping node ' (blank id) - doesn't tell instructor which step/answer is wrong. Planned (not yet generated) playbooks are also editable and a concurrent AI write could overwrite instructor edits.

integration_issues.issue: When the backend 500s (custom playbook in category), PlaybookPanel silently shows 'No playbook covers this alert type yet' instead of an error.

issues: After Submit, challenge-result (with pb-result) renders below the fold; no auto-scroll so user may miss the playbook verdict.
Panel for Linux SSH brute force challenge (ch-02-1) lists the Windows 4625 SIEM playbook first - category match only, content mismatch (minor).
